Second FESS AFB PCR probe was positive
response.rationale: Positive AFB PCR from two sites is definitive for tuberculosis, overriding the negative initial AFB stain. Noncaseating granulomas and mediastinal lymphadenopathy also occur in sarcoidosis, but the positive PCR and normal ACE favor TB. GPA is contradicted by negative ANCA and noncaseating (not necrotizing) granulomas.

rejected.why: Chronic rhinosinusitis is too nonspecific and does not explain mediastinal lymphadenopathy or positive AFB PCR.
Negative ANCA and noncaseating granulomas argue against granulomatosis with polyangiitis; positive AFB PCR is incompatible.
Sarcoidosis fits noncaseating granulomas and lymphadenopathy but is contradicted by positive AFB PCR and normal ACE.
